data.name: Chandhu
data.gender_notes: Chandhu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Chandhu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chandra', which means 'Moon'. In Hindu mythology, the moon is personified as the god, Chandrama, and is revered for his calming and nurturing influence. The name Chandhu carries the meaning “Moon God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chandhu usually hope their child will grow to embody moon god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Chandhu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chandhu total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
